cases.name: rounded_cube
cases.note: Control: the cube with its four vertical edges rounded R5, no chamfer.

volume.formula: (30*30 - (4 - pi)*5^2)*30 (the cube less the four R5 rounds of its vertical edges) (tol: 0.1 % of the rounds)

cases.name: chamfer_3_round_the_rounds
cases.note: Chamfer 3 on the bottom loop (four lines and four arcs, picked in the issue's order): the arcs' chamfers are cones whose apexes stay 2 mm short of the rounds' axes. On SolidCraft 0.29.0 (truck) this builds with four cone faces.

volume.formula: (30*30 - (4 - pi)*5^2)*30 (the cube less the four R5 rounds of its vertical edges) - 4*10*3^2 - pi*3^2*(5 - 3/3) (the chamfer below the bottom face, by the coarea formula: int_0^3 (3 - s)*(8*10 + 2*pi*(5 - s)) ds, the perimeter of the bottom face's inward offset s times the chamfer's height 3 - s there; on the four arcs it is Pappus's cone sections, the triangle of legs 3 at radius 5 - 3/3 from the rounds' axes) (tol: 0.1 % of the rounds and the chamfer)

cases.name: chamfer_4_round_the_rounds
cases.note: Chamfer 4 on the bottom loop: the cones' apexes 1 mm short of the axes. On SolidCraft 0.29.0 (truck) this builds with four cone faces.

volume.formula: (30*30 - (4 - pi)*5^2)*30 (the cube less the four R5 rounds of its vertical edges) - 4*10*4^2 - pi*4^2*(5 - 4/3) (the chamfer below the bottom face, by the coarea formula: int_0^4 (4 - s)*(8*10 + 2*pi*(5 - s)) ds, the perimeter of the bottom face's inward offset s times the chamfer's height 4 - s there; on the four arcs it is Pappus's cone sections, the triangle of legs 4 at radius 5 - 4/3 from the rounds' axes) (tol: 0.1 % of the rounds and the chamfer)

cases.name: chamfer_5_as_wide_as_the_rounds
cases.note: The issue's case: chamfer 5 on the bottom loop, as wide as the R5 rounds, so each arc's chamfer is a cone whose apex is on its round's axis, at a corner of the bottom face (a 20 x 20 square now). On SolidCraft 0.29.0 (truck) the four arcs' chamfers came out as spheres (round's balls) and the volume 119.7 mm^3 too large.
